neighbours.label: setting a quantity against a reference ('compared to/with', 'relative to', 'in comparison', 'against', 'subtracted from')
fire: The new battery lasts far longer when compared to older models from that brand.
Her salary looks modest compared with what peers at rival firms take home.
Rainfall was unusually low this spring relative to the thirty-year average.
Each sample was measured and then compared against the control group.
In comparison to rural clinics, city hospitals have shorter waiting lists.
Housing remains cheap here relative to incomes in the neighbouring counties.
Net profit is what is left after costs are subtracted from revenue.
The team's ratings were benchmarked against those of its main competitors.
quiet: The new battery lasts far longer when stored in a cool and dry place.
Her salary looks modest given how long she has worked at the firm.
Rainfall was unusually low this spring across most of the southern plains.
Each sample was measured and then stored in the freezer overnight.
In rural clinics and city hospitals, waiting lists have grown this year.
Housing remains cheap here thanks to the new towns in the neighbouring counties.
Net profit is reported each quarter after the auditors sign the accounts.
The team's ratings were published alongside those of its main competitors.

notes: Card: ' compared' x13, ' -' x5, ' relative' x2, ' Compare' x2; 'subtracted' and code subtraction also peak, so the shared pattern is a comparison with a reference rather than the one word. Probe: compared 0.704; relative 0.724; checked against 0.421; subtracted 0.332; 'values[i] - baseline[i]' 0.492; 'during the same quarter' 0.019.
